meta.name: Munchkin's Ochre Tome
meta.description: An outrageously over-engineered tome created by the Paradox Symposium of St. Munchkin. Kept permanently while carried or placed in the house, it applies bureaucratic loopholes to reality itself. By consulting the ochre-stained pages while equipped on a tool, nearby ores are legally required to declare themselves upon layer reveal. In exchange, the sheer weight of paperwork drastically slows down your raw DPS.
meta.author: jules:session
